title: Satchel Manifest
description: Product-agnostic source manifest for Satchel agent plugin packages.

schema.description: Satchel schema version. The current schema identifier is satchel/v0.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case package name copied into generated target manifests.

version.description: Package version copied into generated target manifests and archives.

description.description: Short package description copied into generated target manifests.

author.description: Author metadata copied to targets that support it.

homepage.description: Project homepage URL copied where supported.

repository.description: Source repository URL copied where supported.

license.description: Package license identifier copied where supported.

components.description: Shared source components used by one or more generated targets.

skills.description: Portable skill directory. Each child skill needs SKILL.md.

hooks.description: Hook configuration copied or referenced by targets that support hooks.

agents.description: Agent definition directory for targets that support agents.

commands.description: Command definition directory for targets that support commands.

lsp.description: LSP server configuration for targets that support LSP.

rules.description: Rule files copied into experimental Antigravity output.

codex.description: Codex plugin manifest and marketplace output.

claude.description: Claude plugin manifest and marketplace output.

copilot.description: GitHub Copilot plugin manifest and marketplace output.

chatgpt.description: ChatGPT Apps SDK app metadata, submission checklist, and MCP release-readiness output.

anthropic.description: Anthropic Connectors Directory connector metadata and manual submission checklist (distinct from the claude Claude Code plugin target).

cowork.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork plugin manifest (agentSkills + a remote-MCP-only agentConnectors entry from targets.cowork.connector). There is no local/stdio transport; an mcp component server declared via command/args cannot back this target and is flagged, not silently dropped.

component.description: A shared package component path. Use a relative path inside the package root.

enabled.description: Set false to disable this target.

manifest.description: Relative path for the generated target manifest.

rootManifest.description: Optional extra root manifest path used by the Copilot target.

output.description: Output directory for targets that generate local package layouts.

experimental.description: Marks an enabled experimental target as intentionally experimental.

displayName.description: Human-facing display name used by targets that support it.

app.description: ChatGPT app metadata, including the remote MCP URL and submission URLs.

compatibility.description: ChatGPT compatibility checks and expectations such as read-only hints and search/fetch support.

submission.description: ChatGPT submission checklist output path, or a mapping with a path field.

path.description: Relative path for the generated ChatGPT submission checklist.

interface.description: Codex interface metadata copied into the Codex plugin manifest.

path.description: Relative path for the generated marketplace file.

patch.description: Preserve host-owned marketplace metadata while updating generated plugin fields.

source.description: Target-specific plugin source declaration used by marketplace install flows.
